SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id_student || '-' || t1.code_module || '-' || t1.code_presentation) 
FROM studentRegistration t1 
JOIN studentAssessment t2 ON t1.id_student = t2.id_student 
JOIN assessments t3 ON t2.id_assessment = t3.id_assessment 
  AND t1.code_module = t3.code_module 
  AND t1.code_presentation = t3.code_presentation 
WHERE t1.date_unregistration IS NOT NULL;
